# task\-ledger\-settle\-transactional — Make ledger restoration coherent and crash\-recoverable
status: ready  priority: 1  scope: scope-core
readiness: actionable  reason: declared_ready

The October 18 integration audit found that ledger settle restored canonical records separately from events and could leave a partial ledger on interruption\. Writes are disabled in 0\.11\.0; dry\-run remains supported\. Design and implement one coherent restoration transaction through store\.ts, preserving staged work, record/event consistency and recoverable snapshots\. Re\-enable CLI/MCP writes only when the failure cases pass\. Do not restore only a subset of a multi\-record mutation or discard unrelated writers\. See docs/audit\-integration\-2026\-10\-18\.md

## Acceptance
- Interrupted restoration recovers deterministically with a real separate\-process fixture\.
- Partial branch coverage, staged differences and outstanding writers cannot cause record/event divergence or loss\.
